name: Puchong Half Marathon Powered by JomRun®
short_description: A half marathon event in Puchong, Selangor, Malaysia on October 25, 2026, offering 5km, 10km, and 21.1km distances, with registration currently open.
ai_summary: The Puchong Half Marathon Powered by JomRun® is a road race scheduled for October 25, 2026, based at AEON BiG Puchong Utama in Puchong, Selangor, Malaysia. Runners can choose from 5km, 10km, or the primary 21.1km half marathon distance. Registration for the event is currently open, giving participants time to plan and sign up ahead of race day.
pros: Multiple distance options (5km, 10km, 21.1km) suit different fitness levels
Registration is currently open, allowing ample time to prepare
Convenient, accessible venue at AEON BiG Puchong Utama

research_highlights: This is JomRun's first-ever Puchong Half Marathon, so there are no past editions to reference for course conditions or crowd support.
Race offers three distances -- 5KM, 10KM, and 21.1KM -- with the venue at Aeon Big Puchong Utama.
Only the 21.1KM category gets an RFID timing chip and a finisher jersey; the 5KM and 10KM are fun-run categories with bib but no timing chip.
The event is organized/technical-run by JomRun as part of its wider JomRun Half Marathon Series across Malaysian cities.
Online registration was set to close the day before race day (24 October 2026, 23:59 GMT+8), and the JomRun app is required for participants.
research_watchouts: Local community members expressed concern in early social media discussion about traffic congestion in Puchong (an area already prone to jams, particularly around the LDP highway), questioning how the route would navigate around it.
Some commenters felt the initial finisher medal design's building imagery did not clearly represent or identify Puchong, suggesting it needed revision.
As a brand-new (inaugural) route, there is no first-hand participant race-day feedback yet on course marking, water stations, heat management, or organization quality.

faqs.question: When is the Puchong Half Marathon Powered by JomRun® taking place?
faqs.answer: The Puchong Half Marathon Powered by JomRun® is scheduled to take place on October 25, 2026. This date has been confirmed for the event, giving participants a clear timeframe to prepare their training schedules and make necessary travel or accommodation arrangements ahead of race day in Puchong, Selangor, Malaysia.

faqs.question: What distances can I run in this event?
faqs.answer: Participants can choose from three distance options at this event: 5km, 10km, and the primary 21.1km half marathon distance. This range allows runners of varying experience and fitness levels to select a distance that best matches their personal running goals and training background.

faqs.question: Where is the race held?
faqs.answer: The race is held at AEON BiG Puchong Utama, located in Puchong, Selangor, Malaysia. This venue serves as the base for the event, making it a central point for runners to gather, start, and finish their respective 5km, 10km, or 21.1km races.

faqs.question: Is registration still open for this race?
faqs.answer: Yes, registration for the Puchong Half Marathon Powered by JomRun® is currently open. Interested runners can sign up now to secure their spot in the 5km, 10km, or 21.1km half marathon category ahead of the October 25, 2026 race date.
